text: Free RPG demo that looks like a lost Super Nintendo classic, set in England, eleven seventy-three.
A healer's apprentice and a guilt-ridden ex-executioner, both arrested for illegal magic.
You forge your own spells, trade favours with lords and peasants, and keep your humours in balance.
Best part: the combat. Spells sit on a glowing ring of planets around your party.
The catch? Walking around, the characters feel a little stiff.
It's English only, and all ten reviews of the demo so far are positive.
Think Chrono Trigger, with medieval politics.
Worth a dip if you miss sixteen-bit RPGs.
